subject: Working session scheduling: hands-on enablement, access & recording
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmepay.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Chen <victor.chen@acmepay.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: POC working session and logistics

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're ready to move to a hands-on POC working session focused on prompt review, routing tests, and a short load run to validate latency under our typical batch sizes. A couple of logistical questions before we lock in a date: 

- We have a small on-site room at our SF office (capacity 10) but a few engineers will join remotely. Can you do a hybrid session with the same facilitator on-site and a stable recording?
- Visitor access: our security team needs the vendor to complete a short access form and provide a name list. Is that something Redwood can fill out in advance?
- Screen sharing & recording: we want to record high-level walkthroughs but one of our engineers (Victor) cannot be recorded during live pairing due to regulations. Can we scope recordings to facilitator screens only?
- Timing: week of Nov 29 or Dec 6 are ideal for us. We prefer mornings PST.

Agenda items we expect: prompt review (30m), routing & model variant discussion (30m), load test with 50-100 concurrent requests (45m), open items + next steps (15m).

If you can confirm availability and the checklist items (access form, recording permissions, AV needs), we’ll circulate a calendar invite and request badges.

Best,
Lina Torres
Head of Integrations, AcmePay

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC working session and logistics

Hi Lina —

Thanks for the detailed notes. We can absolutely run a hybrid, and we’ll make sure facilitator screen-only recording is the default. A couple of quick confirmations and asks so we schedule the right setup: 

- Dates: Nov 30 or Dec 1 morning PST work on our side. Can you confirm which you prefer?
- Visitor access: please attach the vendor access form to your reply — we’ll complete and return it. We also need the list of external attendee names by 48h prior to the on-site day for badge pre-registration.
- Recording scope: we’ll disable participant recordings on the Zoom session and only record the main facilitator window; we’ll also produce a short edited clip of the load test for your internal review. If Victor needs to avoid appearing on the recording, we’ll coordinate a separate pairing window or have him join on audio-only.
- AV: we’ll bring a USB-C hub + our own conference laptop, but please confirm the meeting room has HDMI and a working mic. If not, Marissa can bring a go-mic.
- Pre-workshop checklist: we’ll share a one-page checklist (access, accounts, sample prompts) and a short pre-read on routing profiles. Completing those 3 days ahead will make the load test much smoother.

Proposed agenda (high level):
- 09:00–09:20 Introductions & goals
- 09:20–09:50 Prompt review + guardrails
- 09:50–10:20 Routing & model variant mapping
- 10:20–11:10 Load run (step-up to 100 concurrent requests)
- 11:10–11:30 Action items & next steps

If Nov 30 or Dec 1 works, we’ll send an invite with calendar options and links. I’ll put Marissa on copy to coordinate the checklist and attachments.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmepay.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, aisha_rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC working session and logistics — checklist + attachments

Hi Lina —

Attaching a short POC checklist and visitor access form to this thread. Also attaching a first-pass agenda (Agenda_v1.docx). Quick notes: 

- Redwood-POC-checklist.pdf: includes account setup, API keys, sample prompts, and suggested test weights for routing. Please complete sections A & B before the session.
- Visitor-Access-Form.docx: fill in teammate names + company badges; send back to me and I’ll confirm badge creation with your security contact.
- Agenda_v1.docx: feel free to edit — I left space for Victor’s non-recording window and a 15-minute breakout for prompt tuning.

We’ll also bring a spare laptop for the load run so we don’t conflict with presenter recordings. Marissa (me) will own AV fallback.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC working session and logistics — small reschedule request

Hi team,

Quick note — Nov 30 looks tight for one of our compliance windows. Would Dec 2 (Thursday) morning PST be possible instead? Same agenda. Also to reiterate: I cannot be recorded while doing live code/prompt pairing — I appreciate the facilitator-only recording option. If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute private pairing in the afternoon (recording off) for deeper prompt tuning after the load run.

Thanks,
Victor
Senior Platform Engineer, AcmePay

Thanks Victor — Dec 2 morning PST works for us. I’ve gone ahead and: 

- Reserved Dec 2, 09:00–12:00 PT as the working session window and will send a calendar invite with two dial-in options (Zoom + GMeet) and a facilitator-only recording setting.
- Noted Victor’s non-recording requirement and scheduled a 20-minute private pairing slot at 14:00 PT with recordings disabled.
- Uploaded the pre-workshop checklist and access form to our secure project folder: https://redwood.app/s/ACME-POC-9123 (please complete sections A & B by Nov 30).
- HubSpot deal updated: https://hubspot.com/deal/9123 — I added the session as a milestone and linked the attachments.
